errors.evidence: The description states the values are in 'millions (billions)', which is contradictory and incorrect. The legend clearly states 'в млрд.' which translates to 'in billions'.
The description of the Y-axis fails to mention its label, which is 'Купувачи (в млрд.)' (Buyers in billions) according to the legend. It only says it is labeled with numerical values.
The chart displays a blue area chart for the 'Купувачи' data, not a blue line. The description incorrectly calls it a 'Синя линия' (blue line).
